requests.title: Manage Requests
requests.description: Review and approve user content requests

timeAgo.days: {count, plural, =1 {1 day ago} other {# days ago}}
timeAgo.hours: {count, plural, =1 {1 hour ago} other {# hours ago}}

rejectDialog.title: Reject Request
rejectDialog.description: Optionally provide a reason for rejecting this request.

torrentMissing.description: The download client no longer has this download (since {date}), so this request cannot complete. Delete it or ask the requester to try again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete request
deleteDialog.description: Permanently delete the request for "{title}"? This removes it from the requester’s list and cannot be undone. Anything already in the download client is left untouched.

queue.overdue: {count, plural, =0 {No availability checks overdue} one {# availability check overdue} other {# availability checks overdue}}
queue.failed: Availability queue could not be loaded.

recheck.failed: Availability check needs attention. Bookmark will retry.

diagnostics.title: Progress details and recovery
diagnostics.failed: Progress details could not be loaded.
diagnostics.recoveryFailed: Recovery failed. Check the progress details.
diagnostics.reconcileDescription: Bookmark does not know if this download was started. This checks, and starts it only if it was not.
diagnostics.retryDescription: This download was never started. This sends the same download request again.
diagnostics.checkClient: Check or resume the existing transfer in the download client. A temporary error does not authorize a replacement.

metadata.title: Fix Metadata
metadata.description: Find library items that are still missing metadata, and fill it in.
